decisive_items: directed an online-bought handheld high-intensity LED light at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
response.rationale: High-intensity LED exposure with characteristic outer retinal OCT disruption and subsequent recovery indicates phototoxic maculopathy; solar retinopathy is sun-specific and photoreceptor damage is a tissue-level description rather than the clinical diagnosis.

rejected.why: Solar retinopathy specifically refers to sun exposure; the exposure here was to a high-intensity LED light, making phototoxic maculopathy the more accurate diagnosis.
